newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel says Jewish settlement to start this week.
newsitem.headline: Israel says Jewish settlement to start this week.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said after meeting Jordan's King Hussein on Sunday that Israel would stick to its plans to begin building a Jewish settlement this week in Arab East Jerusalem.

"There is no change in our decision. Friends can, as I said, agree and sometimes disagree. We understand the worries, the worry that exists on the Palestinian side and other sides. But we have taken our decision," he told a news conference.
"I said that they would start this week. They will start this week," Netanyahu said.
